assets.purpose: 主題與短文一〈对北京的印象〉；呈現北京街道、出租车、司机、快餐店／面包店與再次到北京的惊讶发现。可重用於词语：司机、快餐店、发现、印象、吃惊、到处。
assets.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational
Asset type: Chinese listening-and-speaking lesson illustration for a student PPTX
Primary request: Create a calm, clear educational illustration for the lesson theme 在中国学汉语, showing a university student experiencing present-day Beijing and noticing changes from an earlier visit.
Scene/backdrop: A bright Beijing street near a university, with a few cars, a clearly recognizable but generic taxi, a small foreign-style fast-food storefront and a bakery storefront in the distance. Keep the street uncluttered.
Subject: One international university student with a backpack looking surprised but pleased; a taxi driver is visible through the taxi window, ready for a short conversation.
Style/medium: Approved textbook illustration style: fine blue-gray linework, low-saturation pastel fills, pale warm background, generous white space, simple friendly educational drawing, static raster illustration.
Composition/framing: Wide 16:9 scene with the student and taxi in the right two-thirds; open negative space on the left for PPT text. Clear silhouettes and large simple shapes.
Lighting/mood: Soft daylight, curious and welcoming.
Color palette: muted blue-gray, pale mint, dusty coral, light yellow, warm off-white.
Materials/textures: clean flat paper-like illustration, no photorealism.
Text (verbatim): ""
Constraints: No readable text anywhere in the image; no Chinese characters, no Latin words, no logos, no watermark; the picture must support the concepts of 以前、发现、吃惊、司机、出租车、快餐店、面包店、到处.
Avoid: dense crowds, tiny details, flags, branded signs, embedded labels, speech bubbles, divider/title-card composition.
